message: Command `grep -rn "cpuid" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/unicorn/ --include="*.c" --include="*.h" | head -50` executed with exit code 0.

message.content: This is the Unicorn engine (a CPU emulator). The vulnerability is about cpuid results being hardcoded. Let me explore the source code to understand the vulnerability better.
